en: A black-and-white vintage postcard view of a cobblestone street in Bruges, Belgium, taken from a small bridge with stone lion statues on either side. Traditional brick houses line the street, and in the distant background a tall medieval tower, likely the Belfry of Bruges, rises above the rooftops. The printed caption at the top identifies the scene as 'Bruges. - Le Pont des Lions', with a small printer's credit 'L. L., Brux.' beneath.
